texts.zh:
[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已宣布，所有虚空虫不再被允许进入成员国的恒星系。

在它们被消灭或自行离开我们的宇域之前，[this.GetName]将被视为违反星系法。
texts.en:
The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has declared that all Voidworms are no longer permitted within member nation systems.

Until they are eliminated or leave our space of their own accord, the [this.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law.

texts.zh:
一支虚空虫舰队已进入[from.GetName]星系内的我们的空间。作为[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员，我们有法律义务立即处决在我们边界内的任何虚空虫。

[this.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直到虚空虫离开我们的空间或被消灭。
texts.en:
A fleet of Voidworms has entered our space in the [from.GetName] system. As a [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] member, we are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any Voidworms present within our borders.

The [this.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law until the Voidworms have either departed our space or are exterminated.

texts.zh: 虚空虫一直存在于我们的[invaded_system.GetName]星系，使我们严重违反了星系法中关于虚空虫灭绝决议的内容。这导致[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]允许成员投票对[this.GetName]实施制裁。
texts.en: The continued Voidworm presence in our [invaded_system.GetName] system is a significant Breach of Galactic Law under the Voidworm Eradication resolution. This has resulted in [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] allowing members to vote for sanctions to be imposed on [this.GetName].
